rationale: Replaced aggressive PI (Kp=1.0,Ki=0.20,tau=0.8s,ff=0.57, hard cut only at 0.70/0.80) with delay-robust low-gain PI + asymmetric rate limiter + 6s look-ahead governor. Kp 1.0->0.40 with clipped error, Ki 0.20->0.05 with freeze when |e|>0.18 or yf>0.70, filter 0.8->1.5s, ff center 0.57->0.545, max increase 0.15/s / max decrease 0.60/s, safety caps 0.68->0.25 / 0.72->0.10 / 0.78->0 and predicted yf+6*slope caps 0.70->0.40 / 0.75->0.25. This caps in-flight pumping, stops windup during the 15s deadtime, and cuts early for water already in transit, while keeping same hold-u for nominal 1-2s plant.
